title: UK Domain Registrar 123 Reg Reported Customer Data Exposure in Cyberattack Involving ARTEX AI Tool
summary: 123 Reg, a UK domain registrar owned by GoDaddy, reported unauthorized access to customer data, including names, phone numbers, and business tax registration numbers. A spokesperson said that the company observed the ARTEX AI security-testing tool during the intrusion. The registrar said access was limited to reading the data and that the intruder may have made copies.
